subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If a required pass fails or exceeds its bound after bounded retry, then the system shall record the pass `review-absent`, preserve partial evidence, and keep the aggregate non-accepting until the complete exact-revision pass set succeeds
intent: the failed pass, bound, retry count, and non-accepting aggregate
fit_criterion: injected backend error and timeout never yield acceptance or an unbounded wait; a recovered full-set rerun converges
